meta.title: Forgot password shows the same code screen for unknown, phoneless and verified accounts
meta.requirement: AC5 — identical response; code only when a verified phone exists
precondition: Unknown name; QA-USER without phone; QA-VERIFIED user
steps: Forgot password → submit an unknown username → read the code screen
Compare screens and the API log's SMS lines
expected: All three submissions land on auth.reset with identical texts (countdown digits ignored) — UI tree
Event password_reset_requested for each submission — event log
SMS log: no new line for the unknown and no-phone names; exactly one new 6-digit code for the verified user — API log

1.observed: on reset: True,True,True; same texts: True

3.observed: codes after unknown+no-phone: 0; verified got a 6-digit code: True
